policy.name: Tripura Industrial Investment Promotion Incentive Scheme (TIIPIS), 2022 (continued under Tripura Industrial Investment Policy (TIIP) 2024, notified 07.10.2024)
policy.order_no: Notification No. F.Dr/SUBSIDY/TIIPIS, Department of Industries & Commerce, Government of Tripura

zone_lookup: Sector-based, not geographic: Thrust sector list on the Dept of Industries & Commerce 'Thrust Sector' page / TIIPIS 2022 annexure (not read).

schemes.name: TIIPIS 2022 State Capital Investment Subsidy - non-thrust MSME
schemes.notes: Official text: new MSMEs 30% of fixed capital investment, ceiling Rs 100 lakh (thrust sector 40%, Rs 125 lakh); ST/SC/PH/women-owned units get 5% more within the same ceiling. Single instalment. Clause 7.2(c): units with plant & machinery above Rs 1 crore must claim the P&M subsidy under the central scheme (UNNATI 2024), so this rule is limited to P&M up to Rs 1 crore.

schemes.name: TIIPIS 2022 State Capital Investment Subsidy - thrust sector MSME
schemes.notes: Official text: new MSMEs 30% of fixed capital investment, ceiling Rs 100 lakh (thrust sector 40%, Rs 125 lakh); ST/SC/PH/women-owned units get 5% more within the same ceiling. Single instalment. Clause 7.2(c): units with plant & machinery above Rs 1 crore must claim the P&M subsidy under the central scheme (UNNATI 2024), so this rule is limited to P&M up to Rs 1 crore.
conditions: Thrust-sector unit as listed in the policy

schemes.name: Industrial Promotion Subsidy (net SGST reimbursement)
schemes.notes: Official text: net SGST paid in cash reimbursed for 5 years from commercial production, annual ceiling Rs 80 lakh (thrust Rs 125 lakh); total over 5 years capped at 150% of plant & machinery investment (the ceiling modelled here). Units starting production 1 Apr 2022 - 31 Mar 2027.

schemes.name: TIIPIS 2022 Partial reimbursement of term-loan interest - non-thrust
schemes.notes: Official text: 4% interest reimbursement on term loans for 5 years from commercial production, ceiling Rs 5 lakh a year (thrust sector 5%, Rs 12 lakh a year); no overdue interest.

schemes.name: TIIPIS 2022 Partial reimbursement of term-loan interest - thrust
schemes.notes: Official text: 4% interest reimbursement on term loans for 5 years from commercial production, ceiling Rs 5 lakh a year (thrust sector 5%, Rs 12 lakh a year); no overdue interest.
conditions: Thrust-sector unit as listed in the policy

schemes.name: TIIPIS 2022 Power subsidy (connected load above 20 HP)
schemes.notes: Official text: units with connected load above 20 HP get Rs 5.00 per unit on power charges paid to TSECL for the first 5 years, no upper ceiling. Units up to 20 HP get 25% of power charges (cap Rs 15 lakh a year, thrust Rs 25 lakh) instead; not modelled because the app does not read the power bill amount.

schemes.name: TIIPIS 2022 Reimbursement of standard certification fees
schemes.notes: Official text: one-time 100% reimbursement of fees for ISO 9000/14000/18000, BIS, BEE, FSSAI, AGMARK, ZED and other listed certifications, plus yearly renewals.

other_benefits: UNVERIFIED: SGST reimbursement 100% of SGST, ceiling Rs 80 lakh (non-thrust) / Rs 125 lakh (thrust) PER ANNUM - per-annum cap, not a % of investment, so not encoded as sgst_refund_ceiling.
UNVERIFIED: transport subsidy raised to 50% (news, April 2022).
UNVERIFIED: infrastructure developers 30% of capital investment up to Rs 500 lakh (>=30 acres).
